item.title: Al-Qadisiyah University Energy ISO Team Holds 2nd Meeting
item.description:
As part of Al-Qadisiyah University’s efforts to enhance sustainability practices, improve energy management efficiency, and reduce emissions, the university’s Energy ISO team held its second regular meeting, chaired by Prof. Dr. Abbas Sabbar, Director of the Quality Assurance and University Performance Department, and attended by all team members alongside a representative from Al-Diwaniyah Governorate.

The meeting covered several key topics regarding the National Initiative to Support Energy and Reduce Emissions and address climate change. The team reviewed Al-Qadisiyah University’s energy management policy to ensure alignment with relevant international standards, contributing to a strong institutional framework for improving energy efficiency and lowering environmental emissions.

item.title: Al-Qadisiyah University to Join Elsevier Conference 2026
item.description:
Al-Qadisiyah University Participates in the Elsevier Impact Conference 2026 in Spain After Scientific Proposal Acceptance to Develop Iraqi Journals

In a new academic achievement that reinforces Al-Qadisiyah University’s international presence, the scientific proposal titled “Enhancing International Visibility of Iraqi Journals through Editorial Reform” has been accepted for inclusion in the scientific program of the Elsevier Impact Conference 2026, which will take place in Madrid, Spain, from November 3 to 5, 2026.

item.title: Al-Qadisiyah University Gains Three Certified Sustainability Trainers
item.description:
University of Al-Qadisiyah Strengthens Capabilities with Three Certified Trainers in Energy Sustainability, Environment, and Climate Change

As part of the efforts of the Quality Assurance and University Performance Department to consolidate concepts of sustainability and build institutional capacities, the University of Al-Qadisiyah has bolstered its staff with three certified trainers. This follows their successful completion of the sixth “Training of Trainers (TOT-Level 3) in Energy Sustainability, Environment, and Climate Change,” hosted by Al-Nahrain University’s Continuing Education Center from June 21 to July 2, 2026.
